title: 第20章：大姑
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
老板，盒饭怎么卖？”

    “15元管饱。”

    “那我要一份。”

    “慢点吃，不够了还能打。”

    “谢谢老板！”

    忙活了整整一天，马超早就饿了，别人眼里重油重盐的快餐，在马超眼里却是难得的美味。“老板，你家饭菜真好吃，能问一下，可以打包吗？”

    “可以。”

    “那我打包三份。”

    “好嘞，看看喜欢吃什么菜。”

    “这个这个还有这个……”

    马超一连指好几个荤菜，准备带回去给家里的弟弟妹妹尝一下。

    接着马超又去称一斤散糖，和打包的快餐一起放进时空屋，等做完这一切，他又回到锚点的公共厕所，趁着没人注意，瞬间回到了80年代。
content_en:
Boss, how do you sell lunch boxes? "

    "15 yuan is sufficient. "

    “Then I want one. "

    “Eat slowly, if you don’t have enough, you can still fight. "

    "Thank you boss! "

    After working for a whole day, Ma Chao was already hungry. Fast food that was heavy in oil and salt in the eyes of others was a rare delicacy in Ma Chao's eyes. “Boss, your food is really delicious. Can I ask if it can be packed? "

    "Can. "

    “Then I’ll pack three portions. "

    "Okay, let's see what we like to eat. "

    "This, this, and this..."

    Ma Chao pointed out several meat dishes in succession, planning to take them back for his younger brothers and sisters to try.

    Then Ma Chao went to weigh a pound of loose sugar and put it into the space-time room together with the packed fast food. After finishing all this, he returned to the public toilet at the anchor point and instantly returned to the 1980s when no one was paying attention.
